video.title: Haptic Feedback, Feedback Generator & Impact Style | Day 123
video.description:
Learn to explain how iOS apps make the device vibrate on a tap: Haptic Feedback, Feedback Generator & Impact Style, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Haptic Feedback - A small vibration from the device that you feel when you touch the screen.
Feedback Generator - An object that creates haptic feedback and can get ready ahead of time.
Impact Style - The strength of a tap vibration, such as light, medium or heavy.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Haptic Feedback, Feedback Generator and Impact Style in English?

dialogue.title: A buzz for the like button

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, can we add Haptic Feedback to the like button?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sure. Use a Feedback Generator, like in the code.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It wakes the hardware, so the vibration has no delay.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good. How strong should it be?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Choose an Impact Style. Light for small taps, heavy for big ones.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The code uses `medium`. Is that fine for a like?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Done. Should every tap have Haptic Feedback?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. Too much is annoying. Use it for important actions only.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then I will keep the Feedback Generator only for the like button.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perfect. Check the Impact Style on a real device, not the simulator.

dialogue.code:
let generator = UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(
    style: .medium)
generator.prepare()
generator.impactOccurred()
